test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All books are pencils.

Some pencils are pens.

All pens are erasers.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some erasers are pencils.

II. All pens are books.

III. Some erasers are pens.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

Statements :

All books are pencils.

Some pencils are pens.

All pens are erasers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9a6a1d11b3a6ca5c970616551691cc3b2debaf7bbe373f624e6f7906d0e1c0c.png] 

Conclusions :

I. Some erasers are pencils → **Follow **→ As all books are pencils and all pens are erasers. So some erasers are pencils is definitely followed.

II. All pens are books → **Does not follow **→ As all books are pencils, some pencils are pens and all pens are erasers. So all pens are books is not definitely followed.

III. Some erasers are pens → **Follow **→ As some pencils are pens and all pens are erasers. So some erasers are pens is definitely followed.

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
